# Lucide health and fitness icon subset

Source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/0.468.0/icons
Version: 0.468.0. 30 selected icons. Original SVG geometry embedded in health-icon-data.json; viewBox24x24, stroke2, currentColor. License: ISC (with upstream Feather attribution retained in LICENSE). No runtime package or UI library is added.
